messages:
Nina (SRE): Quick follow-up from last night's repeated ~6m p95 spikes. Pattern looks like hot-key storms on a small set of routes. Need owners and concrete SLO actions.

Ravi (Platform): I saw the same. My read: cache TTL oscillation + a handful of heavy callers. Suggest two tracks: immediate mitigation (rate-limit top callers, fallback to quantized variants) + medium fix (stabilize TTLs, add request shaping at edge).

Ellie (Service Owner): For our enterprise customers we can't silently degrade. Can we scope degraded paths to non-enterprise API keys?

Ravi (Platform): Yes. We'll route by key labels. Plan: 1) 2% traffic -> quantized fallback for non-enterprise (today), expand to 10% if 24h burn-rate > 1.4. 2) rate-limit top 5 callers with gentle backoff.

Nina (SRE): Proposed temporary SLO window: p95 <= 320ms for 14 days (current 200ms). Only apply to public-hosted non-enterprise tier. Keep p99 unchanged. If 7d burn-rate > 1.2 then pause non-critical deploys.

Jordan (Product): We need a comms stub for affected customers. I'll draft and coordinate with Sales. Also want the dashboard panels to show "top callers by p95" and per-tenant burn-rate.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "SLO remediation check" Mon 09:15 PT. Alert rule added: p95 burn-rate > 1.15 -> notify #eng-oncall + oncall pager.

Nina (SRE): Action items: - Nina: add burn-rate alert + playbook snippet to dashboard (today) - Ravi: implement 2% quantized canary + label routing (today) - Ellie: produce enterprise exception list and confirm endpoints (2d) - Jordan: customer comm template (tomorrow) - Ravi & Nina: TTL audit (5d)

Ravi (Platform): I pushed a PR for label routing and fallback: https://git.internal/routing/PR-619. Includes PromQL alert: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(req_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, api_key))

Ellie (Service Owner): I'll start the enterprise list and mark which tenants require manual opt-out for degraded paths.

Nina (SRE): We'll reconvene after 24h mitigation window to check error-budget trend. Prefer degradation over loosening SLAs, but temporary SLO tweak is approved as a safety valve. Update this thread with owner+due dates in the tracker.

Jordan (Product): Thanks all. I'll post the comms draft in #customer-ops and tag the affected account PMs.

Ravi (Platform): Monitoring note: added panel for per-route p95 and CSV export for top callers. Ping me for access.

Nina (SRE): Logging the postmortem link and action tracker in the playbook repo after owners confirm. Expected update EOD tomorrow.
